lit.\u0027 En un carbono estereogénico, la c: " At a stereogenic carbon, the configuration would be inverted."
lit.\u0027 La disposición espacial de los tr: " The spatial arrangement of the three remaining groups is inverted: (R)-2-bromobutane → (S)-butan-2-ol."
lit.\u0027\u003cstrong\u003e[HO···CH₃···Br]\: "[HO···CH₃···Br]⁻‡ The carbon is pentacoordinate: the three substituents lie in a plane perpendicular to the O···C···Br axis (trigonal bipyramid). Both bonds are partial (order ≈ 0.5) and the negative charge is shared between the nucleophile and the leaving group. It is an energy maximum, not an intermediate: it cannot be isolated."
lit.\u0027\u003cstrong\u003eAtaque dorsal.\u: "Backside attack. The hydroxide ion, with a lone pair of electrons, approaches the electrophilic carbon from the face opposite the bromine (180°). The orbital that receives the electrons is the σ* of the C–Br bond: its larger lobe lies right behind the carbon."
lit.\u0027\u003cstrong\u003eInversión de Wal: "Walden inversion. The C–O bond is completed as the bromide moves away. The substituents flip like an umbrella turned inside out by the wind."
lit.\u0027Ataque dorsal (180°) sobre el σ* d: "Backside attack (180°) on the σ* of the C–X bond → inversion of configuration (Walden)."
lit.\u0027Bimolecular: la velocidad depende: "Bimolecular: the rate depends on both reactants."
lit.\u0027Favorecida por nucleófilos fuertes: "Favored by strong nucleophiles and polar aprotic solvents (DMSO, DMF, acetone)."
lit.\u0027No hay intermediario: el estado de: "There is no intermediate: the transition state [‡] is an energy maximum."
lit.\u0027Un solo paso concertado: el enlace: "A single concerted step: the C–O bond forms as the C–Br bond breaks."
lit.\u0027Velocidad: CH₃– \u003e 1.º \u003e: "Rate: CH₃– > 1° > 2° ≫ 3° (steric hindrance blocks the backside attack)."
